name: Arize Phoenix
tagline: LLM tracing + evaluation. Strong on retrieval debugging.
description: Phoenix is Arize's observability platform — run locally in a notebook or as a hosted service. Especially strong for inspecting RAG pipelines, finding bad chunks, and tracking retrieval quality over time.

changelog.summary: Corrected license signal — Phoenix is Elastic License 2.0 (source-available), not OSI open-source.

edge: Spins up inside a Jupyter notebook and is sharpest at RAG debugging — finding the bad chunk that poisoned retrieval.
cons: Less polished than hosted SaaS evals
Production scale leans on Arize cloud
